name: plan-verification
body: The plan-verification subdomain of the `apg plan verify` coherence gate: its derived-coverage stage and the durable-spec delta that stage is computed from. Its concern is that a project's plan describes exactly the durable spec the change-set touches — no more (no fake `modifies` tasks over untouched pre-existing code) and no less (every changed `implemented-by` claim is covered).
